backlog.from_now: Only new items from now on

reasons.title_not_included: Title does not match the include list
reasons.language_not_wanted: Language is not one of the wanted ones
reasons.backlog: Already existed when the subscription was switched on
reasons.asset_not_wanted: File does not match the platforms, architectures or name patterns

form.name: Name
form.mode_hint: Review first is safer; automatic queueing cannot be undone item by item.
form.backlog_hint: A channel with years of uploads should not enter the queue at once. With the first option, a first poll that only finds older entries reports nothing.
form.patterns_hint: Comma-separated. A pattern in slashes — /^S0\d/ — is a regular expression; anything else is matched as plain text.
form.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored key
form.source_categories_description: Only these categories are requested from the indexer. With none chosen, everything is fetched and filtered afterwards.
form.every_release_description: Without this, an episode counts as had once it has been queued, whatever release, quality or language it arrived in. With it, every further version enters the LinkGrabber again.
form.site_rule_description: The address is a listing page — a series, category or tag page. What is followed are the release pages on it that a rule reads; mirrors arrive in the LinkGrabber as one group.
form.view_description: How this subscription's hits are shown for a decision.
form.autoplay_description: The cards turn every six seconds; the pointer, the keyboard and open details pause them.
form.card_ratio_description: The shape of each card's picture: square for covers, wide for banners.
form.script_description: A file in the service's scripts folder. Every line it prints that is a link is taken, and a link already seen is not taken again. Only the administrator can set up a script subscription.
form.schedule_description: Five fields in the service's local time, e.g. 0 6 * * * for 06:00 every day. Leave empty to use the interval; with a schedule, the interval only sets how soon a failed run is retried.
form.script_arguments_description: One line, split at spaces; "…" or '…' keep an argument with spaces together. No shell: $variables, > redirections, ; and & arrive unchanged. No secrets: arguments are stored in plain text in the database, backups and the audit log.
form.script_arguments_preview: How the arguments reach the script
form.script_arguments_unclosed: A quotation mark is not closed
form.indexer_description: Takes the address, the default categories and a copy of the API key when saving – a copy, not a link
form.indexer_none: None – enter address and key yourself
form.url_from_indexer: Leave empty for the indexer’s address, or paste a saved search from its server
form.api_key_from_indexer: Leave empty for the indexer’s key
form.search_query_description: Sent to the indexer as q, !word excludes. Empty or at least 3 characters. The title filters below stay local.
form.search_max_age_description: Only releases posted within these days; empty asks without a limit
form.search_pretime_description: Sent to the indexer as pred; the indexer defines what 0, 1 and 2 mean
form.git_url_description: The repository's address, e.g. https://github.com/owner/name or https://gitlab.com/group/project.
form.git_forge_description: Recognised for github.com and gitlab.com; name it here for a self-hosted server.
form.git_platforms_description: Only files for these systems, recognised by name or extension (.exe, .dmg, .deb …). Empty means all.
form.git_architectures_description: Files that name no architecture, universal macOS images for instance, always count. Empty means all.
form.git_asset_patterns_description: Comma-separated, * and ? as wildcards, e.g. *.AppImage. Empty means all.
form.git_token_hint: Private repositories only, and the smallest right suffices: a GitHub fine-grained token with “Contents: read”, GitLab “read_api”. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.git_token_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored token

items.title: Items
items.no_details: The indexer said nothing more about this hit.
items.page_limit: This check reached the {limit}-result limit across five indexer pages. The title filter runs afterwards, so still older hits may be missing. Narrower categories make the result more focused.

remove.title: Delete subscription?
remove.description: "{name}" is removed along with its filters, its category routing and the record of what it has already seen.

history.title: Clear completed history for “{name}”?
history.description: {count} completed hits and {runs} check records will be deleted permanently. Open hits remain. Deleted hits may reappear during a later check.
history.done: Deleted {deleted_items} completed hits and {deleted_runs} check records.

notices.poll_started: Check of "{name}" started. The result appears here once it has finished.
notices.poll_start_failed: The check of "{name}" could not be started: {error}
notices.poll_finished: Check of "{name}" finished: {found} found, {accepted} accepted, {skipped} skipped.
